newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Banque Commerciale du Maroc 96 net $66 mln.
newsitem.headline: Banque Commerciale du Maroc 96 net $66 mln.

text.p: Morocco's leading bank Banque Commerciale du Maroc, showed a net profit of 615.8 million dirhams ($66 million) in 1996, up 18.82 percent over the previous year.

BCM, said in a statement published in the press on Monday, that the annual results for its Moroccan operation excluding subsidiaries abroad were disclosed after the board of directors meeting on February 28, 1997.
The pre-tax profit rose 22.25 percent to 942.7 million dirhams over the previous year, the bank said.
The results were acheived due mainly to the performance of client resources which rose 8.73 percent to 23.5 billion dirhams compared with 1995.
"This represented 16.4 percent of the market stake," the bank said.
One of the eight banks listed on the Casablanca stock exchange, BCM has a market capitalisation of 9.6 billion dirhams, the second largest after the private conglomerate ONA Group.
Established in 1929, the Casablanca bourse has 47 listed firms.
